boards.title: Entrer dans le conte
boards.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create realistic, production-quality mobile app UI mockups for N’GAME, a French party game app. This is ONE coherent approved visual system across an entire storyboard, not alternative styles. Match the attached approved paper fairytale reference: sophisticated cut-and-fold paper diorama, midnight blue #101E2C, cream parchment #F5E9CF, muted woodland greens, delicate botanical gold #C9A875, terracotta #A45B3D buttons, warm amber windows. Cormorant Garamond style literary serif headings, Manrope style body copy. Enchanting, premium, tactile, fully art-directed; never generic dashboard or flat wireframe. Paper village, bridge, river, clouds and moon should feel ready to animate. No floating lantern; lamps must sit on buildings, ground or a hand. Preserve the approved character-card art.

OUTPUT: a high-resolution landscape review board, target 2048 x 1200, containing exactly FOUR equal upright full app screens side by side, each logically 430 x 932. App content only, sharp rectangular screens; no phone bodies, notches, Dynamic Islands, status bars, device shadows, perspective or tilted screens. Neutral deep navy outside the four screens, generous equal gutters. Above each screen a small legible French screen name, below a small identifier. Do not squeeze text or clip content. Each screen needs one clear purpose and one primary action. All in-app text in correct concise French. Normal readable body 15–17px at logical screen size. Illustrations must remain spacious, not hidden behind giant opaque panels. Form screens can use parchment surfaces; game scenes should remain immersive.

LOCKED COMPONENTS AND POSITIONS inside EVERY 430 x 932 screen:
- Navigation header fixed, height 80. Leading icon center x=34,y=38, 44x44 hit area. Trailing help/settings icon center x=396,y=38,44x44. Short centered section name.
- Outside an active game, leading icon is Back, except root home uses N’GAME emblem.
- INSIDE ANY ACTIVE GAME, including night, role reveal, day, vote, spectator and final result: leading icon is a THREE-LINE HAMBURGER MENU. NEVER a back arrow, home button, close button or direct quit icon in the gameplay header.
- Main content y=96..740. Heading near y=116, explanatory subtitle below, generous space.
- Fixed bottom dock on every screen, dark/navy or parchment matching readability: PRIMARY button x=24,y=846,w=382,h=56, radius about18, terracotta fill, cream serif label. SECONDARY control x=24,y=790,w=382,h=44, quiet outline/subtle surface. These controls NEVER move up or down between screens. When no primary action is currently allowed, show a clearly disabled waiting state IN THE SAME SLOT.
- In game the secondary control is the private role control, always in its same slot. The primary is the current phase action. Changing role, daylight or selection must not reposition controls.
- No floating middle-screen CTA. No extra third bottom row. No permanent tab bar during the game. Leave safe bottom space.
- Never put “Quitter” on the live-game surface. Quitting is only in a hamburger menu, then a separate confirmation where the safe primary is “Rester dans la partie”.
- Hidden-role screens must not show another player's secret. Public avatars are stable identities, unrelated to role assignments.
- Keep icons, button sizes, text sizes and visual spacing identical across boards. Do not introduce another art direction.
These are PROPOSED screens for human approval, not screenshots of an already implemented app. Current-date anchor 17 October 2026, but no calendar dates need appear.
BOARD “ENTRER DANS LE CONTE”. Four screens, from left to right:
A01 ACCUEIL: parchment book-world landing, N’GAME wordmark, headline “Une soirée, mille histoires.” A gorgeous open pop-up storybook with a miniature moonlit village and folded wolf. Lower supporting text “Des jeux à vivre ensemble.” Fixed primary “Créer une soirée”; fixed secondary “Rejoindre une soirée”. Small unobtrusive icon “Les jeux” in main content, not another footer CTA. Top left emblem, top right gear.
A02 LES JEUX: chapter library, heading “Choisissez votre histoire.” One large illustrated Loup-Garou chapter cover; small metadata “6–24 personnes · chacun son téléphone”. Two smaller understated chapter spines “Président — À venir”, “Mimes — À venir”; do not design a Président game environment. Fixed primary “Découvrir Loup-Garou”; fixed secondary “Rejoindre une soirée”.
A03 LOUP-GAROU game information: majestic nocturnal paper wolf/village artwork occupying upper-middle; title “Loup-Garou”, subtitle “Un village. Une meute. Vos secrets.” Two calm text lines “Bluff et déduction” and “6–24 personnes”. Tiny 6–7 player note “Format découverte N’GAME”. Fixed primary “Choisir ce jeu”; secondary “Lire les règles”.
A04 TON COMPAGNON: identity setup, heading “Qui entre dans le conte ?”, single elegant name input filled “Mathis”, six round paper avatars with a visible gold selection ring, “Ton portrait ne révèle jamais ton rôle.” Room to breathe. Fixed primary “Continuer”; secondary “Changer de portrait”.
Warm parchment in onboarding, blue village illustrations; same terracotta buttons, same identical geometry. Use only the left home and middle Werewolf parts of reference image 3; ignore its Président screen.
